introduction: The University of Central Punjab provides its students with innumerable academic, extra and co-curricular experiences, which equip them with skills and knowledge that stay with them beyond their years at university. Students and alumni have succeeded in contributing to the fields of health, business, technology, law, engineering, media, and science.

computer_science.program_description: The BSCS programme offers a wide range of courses helping the students in acquiring expertise in computer applications, modern theoretical aspects of computer science, programming techniques and efficient utilization of technology. Students will participate in seminars, workshops as well as competitions to ensure that they keep up the latest trends in the field.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 50% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS/A-level or equivalent with mathematics.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.

software_engineering.program_description: Software Engineering is the application of a systematic, disciplined, and quantifiable approach to the design, development, operation, and maintenance of software systems. It is the practice of designing and implementing large, reliable, efficient, and economical software by applying the principles and practices of software engineering.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 50% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS/A-level or equivalent with mathematics.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.

pharm_d.program_description: The Pharm.D programme aims at consolidating rigorous basic science education with extensive and clinical experiences so that graduates will be equipped to contribute to revolutionizing the future of health care through new discoveries and developments to improve health and lives of others.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 60% marks in F.Sc. (Pre-Medical) / A Levels (Biology, Chemistry & Physics) or equivalent
All applicants are required to pass the UCP Admission Test

data_science.program_description: The BSDS Programme is an exciting initiative of the Department of Computer Science, Faculty of IT. The programme explores the theoretical foundations of information and data science and chooses a practical approach to applied data analytics as a profession.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 50% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS/A-level or equivalent with mathematics.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.

artificial_intelligence.program_description: The Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence (AI) will equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to design, develop, and evolve software solutions that harness the latest advances in artificial intelligence (AI). The BS AI program enables students to get hands-on experience, developing AI-driven software solutions with the support of state-of-the-art research labs under the guidance of world-class faculty.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 50% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS/A-level or equivalent with mathematics.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.

electrical_engineering.program_description: The BS Electrical Engineering programme focuses on providing a good understanding of development, maintenance and management in the field of robotics, control systems, telecommunication and building services. Students are taught to analyse, test and modify processes based on findings, providing them with hands-on experience using highly updated technology and equipment.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 60% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Engineering/ICS with (Maths, Physics & Computer Science/Studies) A levels with (Maths, Physics & Chemistry)/DAE in Electrical/Electronic Technology or equivalent.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.

mechanical_engineering.program_description: The BS Mechanical Engineering is a programme that is best fit for people whose strengths lie in math and science with interests in materials, robotics, design, high-performance machinery, manufacturing and mechanical operations. The BS Mechanical Engineering cultivates learning and problem-solving abilities needed to modify, develop and exercise responsible leadership through times of swift change.

admission_criteria.criteria: Minimum 60% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Engineering/F.Sc. Pre-Medical/ICS with Mathematics, Physics or Equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. In the case of a foreign qualification, equivalence from IBCC will be required.

A Diploma of Associate Engineer (DAE) Examination in Mechanical with any specialization, or Aerospace, Auto & Diesel, Automation, Bio-Medical, or Dies & Mould, Mechatronics, Precision Mechanical and Instruments, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, or Vacuum or any relevant discipline securing at least 60% marks in aggregate.
A combination of Biology, Physics, and Chemistry is also allowed for admission subject to the successful completion of an Eight-week condensed course in Mathematics.
All applicants are required to pass the PEC-approved test or UCP Admission Test.

civil_engineering.program_description: The BS Civil Engineering programme at UCP provides a learning environment for people who have an interest in natural and man-made environments. The programme focuses on technical knowledge of design, construction, implementation and maintenance of several kinds of infrastructures.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 60% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Engineering/ICS with (Maths, Physics & Computer Science/Studies) A levels with (Maths, Physics & Chemistry)/DAE in Civil Technology or equivalent.
ICS background students taking admission in engineering programs are required to take an additional course in Chemistry in the 1st semester of their degree program.

cyber_security.program_description: A Bachelor of Science in Cyber Security program is designed to educate students on the growing risks and challenges in the digital landscape and how to safeguard data, systems, and networks from malicious attacks, breaches, and unauthorized access.

admission_criteria.criteria: At least 50% marks in F.Sc. Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering/ICS/A-level or equivalent with mathematics.
Applicant has to clear UCP test/NTS/HAT.
